examples.english: The house was full of people.

examples.arabic: كانت الصيفية الماضية ببيروت، شمسها الذهبية عم تغمر بيوتنا القديمة وشوارعنا المزدحمة بالناس.
examples.english: Last summer in Beirut, its golden sun was embracing our old houses and our streets crowded with people.
examples.transliteration: Kaanat es-sayfiyeh el-madhiyeh b-Beirut, shams-ha edh-dhahabiyeh 'am taghmor buyoot-na el-qadimeh w shaware'-na el-mozdaheme bi-nnas.
examples.storyTitle: City Summer and the Taste of Togetherness

examples.arabic: اقتربنا من بياع شاطر كان عم يبيع بندورة وخيار مستويين بأعداد كبيرة، والناس حوليه عم يسألوا عن الأسعار.
examples.english: We approached a clever vendor who was selling ripe tomatoes and cucumbers in large quantities, with people around him asking about prices.
examples.transliteration: Iqtarabna min bayya' shater kan 'am yibee' banadura w khiyar mustawwayn b-a'daad kbeereh, w in-naas hawleih 'am yis'alu 'an il-as'aar.
examples.storyTitle: A Delightful Shopping Day in the Old Souk

examples.arabic: الناس بالبداية ما فهموا قصده، وفكروا إنو نسي مين عم يدفع مصاريف الحديقة.
examples.english: The people initially didn't understand what he meant, and thought he forgot who was paying for the garden's expenses.
examples.transliteration: En naas bil bidaaya ma fahimu qasdo, w fakkaru inno nisi min 'am yidfa' masareef el hadeeqa.
examples.storyTitle: The Bill Problem at the Public Garden: News from Karm El Zeitoun

examples.arabic: الناس في الشوارع، من دمشق إلى بيروت ومن رام الله إلى عمان، يتحدثون عن مستقبل أطفالهم.
examples.english: People in the streets, from Damascus to Beirut and from Ramallah to Amman, are talking about the future of their children.
examples.transliteration: An-naas fi ash-shawari', min Dimashq ila Beirut wa min Ramallah ila Amman, yatahaddathoon an mustaqbal atfaalihim.
examples.storyTitle: Summit of Hope: Towards Peace in the Levant

examples.arabic: يتذكر كبار السن كيف كانت الأسواق المحلية تعج بالناس وتبيع منتجاتهم اليدوية الشهية، وهم يأملون أن تعود هذه الأيام قريباً.
examples.english: The elders remember how local markets used to bustle with people and sell their delicious handmade products, and they hope these days will return soon.
examples.transliteration: Yatadhakkar kibaar es-sinn kayf kaanat el-aswaaq el-mahalliyya ta'ujj bin-naas wa tabee' muntajaatihim el-yadawiyya esh-shahiyyah, wa hum ya'maloona an ta'ood hadhihi el-ayyaam qareeban.
examples.storyTitle: Evening News Broadcast: Popular Movement and Future Aspirations
